review.reviewer: Refine05 primary-source and pinned-RPC review; W1R65 exact issuer-supervision review
review.evidence: Current registry mutation history and positive member reads close the operator/admin/system/relay roster on both chains, and verified zkSync implementation/registry artifacts exactly match deployed bytes. Native operator minting is not collateral-capped; Arbitrum proxy administration is a single EOA while zkSync has a 3-of-6 Safe. Sygnum's disclosed daily CBS/database/blockchain report supports internal-ledger semantics only. The 2480-unit provider/native supply contradiction and independently signed token-to-unit reconciliation remain unresolved; no financial assurance or human/key independence is claimed. Issuer key custody and native cross-chain reallocation/burn-conservation policy remain unpublished. W2R22 at block 72324383 closes the Safe extension-address census: zero guard, no modules, verified CompatibilityFallbackHandler and identified singleton. R12 independently re-verified the same Safe owners, threshold, module pagination end, zero guard, handler and singleton at zkSync block 72339465 on 2026-10-05, and the singleton's 66016-byte runtime exactly matches the published GnosisSafeL2 verification artifact. Current zkSync and Arbitrum block 511866752 EIP-1967 slots retain the identified implementations and administrators. The distinct 14496-byte administered FIUSD EraVM proxy wrapper remains without verified source or deployed executable correspondence in Blockscout, legacy verification and Sourcify; published generic EVM repository source cannot substitute. Full reachable execution/noninterference proof remains unresolved. Institutional FIPS/HSM/MPC custody disclosures do not bind the named registry/proxy-admin keys or independent Safe signers. The umbrella therefore remains unresolved and no incident-free posture is inferred. W1R65 reviewed the FINMA register dated 3 October 2026, which lists exact issuer Sygnum Bank AG in Zurich as an authorised Bank, category 5; issuer application E.3 establishes prudential supervision, not direct FIUSD product approval or token-to-unit reconciliation.
unresolvedQuestions: Verify full noninterference and reachable execution paths of the identified zkSync Safe singleton and CompatibilityFallbackHandler; the guard/fallback/module address census and singleton's exact 66016-byte deployed-source correspondence are independently re-verified at block 72339465, but these ingredients do not establish a complete execution certificate.

Verify the administered FIUSD zkSync proxy runtime's upgrade/bypass implementation beyond its current EIP-1967 slots; verified implementation/registry artifact matches do not verify the proxy wrapper.
